scope: Pinned PixiJS text pipeline source and merged PR inspection; no PixiJS execution or font benchmark.

repositories.versionNote: Explicit snapshot; release/tag source three files compared with full SHA contents and matched.

license.reuseObligations: Retain applicable copyright and license when code is copied.

findings.claim: Canvas text uses browser measurement and rasterization, then manages reusable textures; it is a mature implementation baseline rather than synthetic glyphWidths.
findings.mechanism: measureText uses text/style/wrap cache; zero spacing path draws whole strings through fillText/strokeText; texture management uses styleKey and usageCount; spacing fallback may split graphemes.
findings.recommendation: Web UI baseline: host Canvas text layout/raster provider, reusable run/paragraph texture cache; fixed numeric labels may use a separate bitmap atlas. Include font asset/load generation, locale/direction and resolution in Egret cache invalidation.
limits: Canvas text is not guaranteed identical across OS fonts or hosts.
The current source key does not itself prove all Egret font-load identities covered.
Nonzero letter/word spacing paths may split text; full shaping/line-break quality remains a product concern.
Do not adopt the source comment about up to40percent faster measurement as Egret benchmark.

findings.claim: Pooled text sources can be reused after upload and are not a persistent recovery source; text textures are explicitly regenerated on context change.
findings.mechanism: CanvasTextPipe registers contextChange and unloads managed texts. HTMLTextSystem initiates texture source upload before returning temporary image/canvas pools.
findings.recommendation: Store text+style+font dependencies as regenerator authority, invalidate texture/mask caches by device generation; do not retain every raster image forever or rely on reused canvas content.
limits: Merged PR Sept7 2026 is upstream maintenance evidence, not a local run.
Regenerated text still depends on available fonts and the actual host provider.
Fixed-frame synthetic restoration from the prior probe does not cover these cases.

findings.claim: Canvas text quads enter the normal batch pipe while renderer-specific text state is indexed by renderer identity.
findings.mechanism: addRenderable adds batchableText to renderer.renderPipes.batch; texture references are refreshed on style/resolution changes and per-renderer GPU state is maintained.
findings.recommendation: Integrate text output into the normal ordered UI batch path, with texture and clip/material barriers; keep shaping/rasterization outside unchanged frame work. Manage the resource in the shared Egret registry.
limits: This is code organization, not proof of no per-frame cost or arbitrary cross-engine state sharing.
Text cache area, upload volume, draw count and quality must be measured with real content.

findings.claim: Per-target stencil and mask-stack metadata must die with their backend render target; global uid-keyed records previously leaked.
findings.mechanism: Merged PR moved per-render-target state to GlRenderTarget/GpuRenderTarget; release notes list the fix.
findings.recommendation: Make render-target cache entries, stencil bookkeeping and mask stack lifetimes explicit owner dependencies; releasing target invalidates every associated entry.
limits: PR and release inspected; backend stencil implementation was not directly read in this Pixi source subset.
Initial guessed source paths returned404, recorded as path discovery failure, not absent functionality.

accessLimits.disposition: Resolved to canvas/CanvasTextPipe.ts via tagged init.ts.
No mechanism claim from missing path; stencil claim limited to inspected merged PR.

openQuestions: Host text provider and font-loading APIs in each launch platform.
Real CJK/emoji/input quality, cache/upload budget and mobile power.
Integration and dependency footprint of the chosen component subset.
